_comment: Example only. provision.sh generates the real infra/machine_config.json (gitignored) with the per-user env filled in. With an explicit machine_config, Fly does NOT auto-inject app secrets into the container, so the gateway's config is passed as the container's own env. fly deploy replaces this container's image (via [experimental] container="app" in fly.toml) with the one built from backend/image/Dockerfile.
